repetition: Two post-source-commit development invocations had byte-identical JSON metrics after excluding elapsed_seconds_local_development.
deviations: The first local pre-source-commit implementation attempt stopped because the logistic comparator treated route-ambiguous demonstrations as irreducible contradictory labels, preventing BCE convergence. Fixed the comparator to exclude only non-discriminating demonstrations before committing final source. Frozen protocol, seeds, thresholds and candidate policy were not changed.
Implementation has only a two-float evidence gate over programmer-supplied relation compositions; not free-form learned association discovery or an integrated neural weight edit.
Extra unrelated facts are separately typed C edges and never compete for shared writable slots; robustness against true capacity interference is NOT established.

Worlds and answers are generated locally; first-use source privacy or external unseen data is not claimed. Development labels were produced in local pre-commit debugging and therefore these cohorts are consumed development cohorts.
